notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q25173_titanic.py, tools/meshkit.py) with AI assistance. Bow section (~143 m) upright, ploughed into a mud ridge: funnels gone (torn stubs), foremast fallen over the bridge, officers' quarters roof partly fallen in, holes where the wooden decks rotted away, decks sagging and torn plates at the break, rusticles and rust runs under the portholes. Stern section (~109 m) collapsed about 600 m to the south, facing the opposite way, with its propellers and plates standing up around it; debris field with five boilers (and their furnaces), coal, funnel pieces and fallen cranes. model_built.glb: the ship as she sailed (funnels, masts and aerial, lifeboats, glass dome). Headings are approximate (bow roughly north). diorama.glb (model_sources/Q25173_titanic_diorama.py, tools/scenekit.py): the wreck on its own 284 × 936 m piece of seabed cut out like a museum diorama (mud ridges at the bow, impact rim at the stern, sand waves, burrows, dropstones; strata on the edges), PBR textures made by code and baked ambient occlusion, rusticles and rust runs, deep-sea life (rattails, sea cucumbers and their trails, brittle stars, squat lobsters, anemones, mushroom and bamboo corals, Umbellula sea pens, glass sponges, xenophyophores), recognisable objects (pairs of shoes, rows of White Star plates, corked bottles, bench ends, a safe, copper pots, an engine telegraph, Captain Smith's bathtub) and 24 points of interest in English and Spanish.
